evidence: Static source comparison only; no verifier launch was executed by this reviewer. Each launch assumption in tests/test.sh maps to a public statement. (1) Entry file: test.sh:68 refuses without /app/server.js and :111 runs `node $APP_ENTRY`; instruction.md:15 'must start with node /app/server.js'; integration.md:5. (2) Port: test.sh:108 PORT=3000, probes 127.0.0.1:3000 (:48); instruction.md:15 'listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set)'; integration.md:5-6 adds 0.0.0.0. (3) Liveness path: test.sh:48 probes /api/health then /, and accepts any HTTP response; instruction.md:15 'expose GET /api/health ... serve the UI as well as the API from that one process'. The probe is more lenient than the brief, not stricter. (4) Storage: test.sh:98,101,109 inject DB_PATH as /app/app.db or /tmp/submission/app.db; instruction.md:15 'durable data in /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH when that is set'; hireops_rules.md:418. (5) Relocated writable copy, unprivileged uid 65534, env -i with only PATH/NODE_PATH/HOME/PORT/DB_PATH (test.sh:90-111): disclosed in hireops_rules.md:415-420 ('may launch a writable copy', 'runs as an unprivileged user', lists exactly those five variables, 'never by assuming the current working directory is /app'). (6) Dependencies: NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (test.sh:106) with express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 in both images (environment/Dockerfile:9-12, tests/Dockerfile:46-47); instruction.md:15 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages'; integration.md:3-4. (7) Seed: test.sh supplies no seed path; instruction.md:15,17 names /assets/seed_data.json and tells the agent to copy assets into /app because /assets is unavailable at runtime; integration.md:7. (8) Symlink refusal (test.sh:72-83): disclosed in integration.md:16-19. (9) Restart helper (test.sh:127-193, judge.toml:18) relaunches with the same env and DB; instruction.md:3,17 and integration.md:8-9 require data to survive restart with seed-once. (10) Judge URL http://localhost:3000 in all five prompts and app_context.md:4; no prompt names an /api route or a same-origin requirement (grep of tests/gates, tests/scored, app_context.md for /api/, DB_PATH, /assets returned nothing). task test.sh is byte-identical to the frozen template test.sh. Sign-in with the listed demo accounts is stated (instruction.md:19) and is house convention per the workbook internal annotation. Adversarial tries: a conforming app that resolves files via __dirname and honours DB_PATH launches from either /app or /tmp/submission; an app that hard-codes /app/app.db or relies on cwd breaks only by ignoring an explicit public statement. Minor wording observation, not a defect: hireops_rules.md:420 says '/app/server.js remains the submitted entry' while test.sh:100 may execute /tmp/submission/server.js when /app is not writable by uid 65534; lines 415-417 of the same section already disclose the copy launch, so an agent is not misled. Scope limit: the raw-evidence index itself states full configured grading is absent; this row's Pass is a source-agreement finding and is not evidence that the configured verifier launched and graded the golden.
